## Purpose
A shadcn/ui primitive (new-york style): A modal dialog (Dialog, Trigger, Portal, Overlay, Content, Header, Footer, Title, Description, Close).

## Responsibilities
- Wraps @radix-ui/react-dialog with the project's Tailwind token classes.
- Exports the parts listed under Purpose.
- 104 lines. It has no project-specific logic: it imports only `cn` from `@/lib/utils` and other `ui` primitives.

## Key elements
The exported components.

None beyond the underlying library's own state.

- **Used by:** the app's components and routes.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **It is stock shadcn code,** so regenerating it with `npx shadcn add dialog` gives an equivalent file.
- **Styles may differ slightly from upstream,** because the classes use this project's tokens.

## How to rebuild this file
Run `npx shadcn@latest add dialog` with this `components.json`, or copy the file.
